Complete independent CPython 3.12.15 captures of the unmodified fixed checker.
Original source computes all expected rows before a capture peer forwards them
at the subprocess boundary. No replacement candidate contributes expected data.
Manifest pins interpreter, whole corpus and live source/schema dependencies.
Report templates preserve original field order/bytes; only the tested candidate
binary SHA256 placeholder is filled at runtime after successful comparison.

Failure captures run the untouched original main AST suffix beginning at its
subprocess call with independently source-generated locals; this avoids rerunning
expensive policy generation while preserving all subsequent failure/artifact
ordering. Seventeen outcomes and post-child artifact/print faults are recorded.
The full original main itself generated the complete successful baseline.

Only this fixed checker is retired. Generic runtime Python and schemas remain
mandatory live drift pins; events/callbacks also retain the generic alert data
generator. No native tool executes Python or changes runtime alert policy.

Callback source-exceptions.json retains the historical raw capture, including
24 pycapnp KjException ASLR stack traces. Independent regeneration reproduces
all policy responses/report bytes and stable error class/message/phase; only
stack addresses vary. These addresses are historical provenance, not evidence
of fresh pycapnp execution. Actual proof normalizes those addresses only and
requires every other output artifact/stdout byte to match exactly.
